data.message: I commit to 18 tons and propose individual opt-ins—not an all-or-nothing deal. Fisher01–25: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50; next500 or100. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Recovery to500 and long-run gains aren't guaranteed. You may choose18 even if others choose10.
